interviewer.setupWizardDialog.appAuthori: App authorization ensures that only authorized users can access the app, and perform certain sensitive actions (such as exporting data, and entering/leaving interviews). It also requires re-authentication after a specific configurable period of inactivity.
interviewer.setupWizardDialog.securingYo: Securing your research data is vital. Interviewer implements two layers of protection: secure data storage, and app authorization checks.
